description: Use this when someone asks what a photo book (Dutch: fotoboek) costs, how foto foto's price compares with other services, or which services sell a layflat book, a linen cover or fine-art paper. Prices one book (binding, cover, paper, pages) at foto foto and at albelli, CEWE, Fotofabriek, Pixum, smartphoto, Kruidvat, Profotonet and Saal Digital, cheapest first, with the page each price was read from. List prices in euros with VAT, without shipping or discounts. For a book that was already made, get_book gives its price with shipping. Free, changes nothing.

binding.description: perfect: the standard binding, where the pages curve towards the spine. layflat: opens completely flat, up to 120 pages.

cover.description: smooth: the standard hardcover. linen: a linen hardcover.

pages.description: Printed pages, an even number from 24 to 300, layflat up to 120. An odd count is rounded up and a count outside the range is moved inside it. Default 78.
